replace siding in front in kind. install hardie lap siding on all other sides, not street visible from the street. at front wood and all architectual elements will remain or be recreated.

all 6 units: interior alterations, demo existing lath and plaster. replace with drywall sheetboard, partial demolition of interior partitions, new interior partitions. bathroom and kitchen renovations, window replacement in-kind. front windows facing street to be wood w/integrated ogee lugs

per adu ordinance no. 162-16, alterations for dwelling unit legalization (415-c & 415-d) w/ accessory dwelling unit process. fire sprinklers throughout 1st floor under separate permit.
